text:
Aj Patel: Quick sync — onboarding zeta13b-v2 weights. HF origin -> S3 mirror failing checksum for shard_02.tar.gz. Anyone seeing this? root manifest: https://huggingface.co/meta/zeta13b-v2/blob/main/manifest.json

infra-bot: mirror-job 7821 started -> status: error (checksum_mismatch). logs: https://internal.redwood/mirror/7821

Kyra L: @Aj Patel I'll take a look. Do we have the original HF sha256 listed? Could be transfer truncation or parallel download issue. :eyes:

Aj Patel: I pulled the file locally and ran:
```
$ sha256sum shard_02.tar.gz
abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890  shard_02.tar.gz
```
HF manifest shows `sha256: 1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j...` so different. Also noticed tokenizer.json vocab_size=32002 but config.json expects 32000 — might be two extra special tokens. Not sure if tokenizer mismatch caused conversion issue.

Maria G.: If tokenizer has 2 extra special tokens we can update our tokenizer loader to accept or remap. For checksum we should re-download via git-lfs or huggingface client: `huggingface-cli repo clone meta/zeta13b-v2` and compare. I can re-trigger mirror with `--no-accelerate` and `--verify`.

Samir: Heads up: Dedicated canary is waiting on weights. Proposed mitigation: pin canary to `zeta13b-v2-small` (quantized) for now; once artifacts validated we switch traffic. @Aj set manifest field `origin_verified: false` if we need a manual gate.

Aj Patel: :thumbsup: Maria please re-run mirror job 7821 with `--verify` flag and drop the new log here. Kyra can you check the S3 object metadata for content-length differences? I'll update onboarding checklist in GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-onboarding/pull/412

infra-bot: mirror-job 7821 retriggered by Maria G. -> queued. ETA ~ 8m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Kyra L: Checked S3: s3://redwood-models/zeta13b-v2/shard_02.tar.gz content-length differs by 512 bytes vs HF. Likely transfer chunking. I'll attempt redownload with `--no-parallel` and verify headers (Content-Length, x-amz-meta-sha256).

Maria G.: Reupload completed, new sha256 `1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j...` matches HF now. Tokenizer fix: added fallback mapping for two tokens; ran local canary inference smoke tests — passes. I'll comment on the PR and mark ready for rollout. :party:
